about_the_game:
Life was never fair not before the accident, and certainly not after. You expected magic, adventure, maybe a crown. Instead, you awaken in a foreign body, forced into an arranged marriage with Zachary, the cold and distant Duke of the North.

Born to the sunlit luxury of the South, you're sent to a frozen, war-torn land plagued by monsters, famine, and unrest. Your new husband is a man of duty, not affection, bound by loyalty to a crumbling crown and now, bound to you.

But even pawns can learn to move.

Will you earn Zachary’s trust and fight beside him to save his people? Or seize your own fate, rise as a villainess, and bring the North under your heel?

What will you become in a world where loyalty is dangerous, and love might just be the ultimate betrayal?

Every choice you make shapes your destiny. Navigate a delicate balance between gaining Zachary’s affection and raising his suspicion. Earn his trust to unlock romance, or let doubt fester and carve a path toward power and rebellion. Will you play the dutiful duchess, or manipulate the game from the shadows as a true villainess? Your actions determine not just relationships, but the future of the North itself. In this world, loyalty is tested and betrayal has a price.

  • Two Diverging Routes: Shape your destiny through two distinct narrative paths: Romance or Villainess. Will you fight for love and loyalty, or seize power on your own terms? Each route offers different challenges, choices, and emotional stakes.

  • 8–10 Hours of Gameplay: Experience a tightly woven narrative full of political intrigue, emotional tension, and personal growth. Every scene is crafted for replayability, with meaningful branches and impactful decisions.

  • Five Unique Endings: Your choices matter, from quiet moments of trust to bold acts of rebellion. Unlock one of five possible endings, including both heartwarming resolutions and darker, more treacherous outcomes.

  • Affection & Suspicion Systems: Your actions affect how Zachary sees you. Gain affection to grow closer and reveal his true self, or raise suspicion and risk pushing him and the North toward chaos.

  • 13 Gorgeous CGs: Relive unforgettable moments through beautifully illustrated scenes that highlight turning points in your journey.

  • Nameable Protagonist: Step into the story as yourself with a protagonist you can name, shaping her morals, choices, and legacy.

  • Mature, Emotional Storytelling (17+): Explore themes of arranged marriage, power, and survival. Includes content warnings for family abuse and emotional manipulation.

  • Rich Fantasy Setting: Inspired by Renaissance Italy and medieval Sweden, navigate a world divided: sun-drenched, decadent South vs. frostbitten, crumbling North rife with tension, mystery, and rebellion.

short_description: In this otome isekai visual novel you're thrown into an arranged marriage with the cold Duke of the North. Explore political tension, shifting loyalties, and two routes: romance or rebellion. Support your husband or betray him like a true villainess and take control of your fate.
